Model questions

WEP20J FAQ

What is the rated capacity of the WEP20J?

The stated rated capacity is 2,000 kg. Final suitability depends on load center, lift height, attachment, and operating conditions.

What is the lift specification of the WEP20J?

The listed lift specification is 205 mm. Confirm the required maximum height and residual capacity before ordering.

What information is needed to quote the WEP20J?

Provide load weight and dimensions, lift height, aisle or route conditions, daily duty, battery requirement, quantity, and destination.
